General ledger journal entry line item

definition.@EndUserText.label: View 1
definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."SourceLedger","d"."CompanyCode","d"."FiscalYear","d"."AccountingDocument","d"."LedgerGLLineItem","d"."Ledger","d"."FiscalPeriod","d"."PostingDate","d"."AccountingDocumentType","d"."GLAccount","d"."ProfitCenter","d"."CostCenter","d"."MasterFixedAsset","d"."FixedAsset","d"."AssetTransactionType","d"."AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency","d"."CompanyCodeCurrency","d"."IsReversed","d"."ReversalReferenceDocument","d"."LedgerFiscalYear","d"."FiscalYearVariant","d"."ChartOfAccounts","d"."ControllingArea","d"."/SAP/1_ASSETCLASS","d"."/SAP/1_COMPANYCODE","d"."/SAP/1_CONTROLLINGAREA","d"."/SAP/1_COSTCENTER","d"."/SAP/1_DISTRIBUTIONCHANNEL","d"."/SAP/1_FINANCIALACCOUNTTYPE","d"."/SAP/1_FUNCTIONALAREA","d"."/SAP/1_GLACCOUNT","d"."/SAP/1_LEDGER","d"."/SAP/1_ORDERID","d"."/SAP/1_ORGANIZATIONDIVISION","d"."/SAP/1_POSTINGDATE","d"."/SAP/1_PROFITCENTER","d"."/SAP/1_SALESDOCUMENT","d"."/SAP/1_SALESORGANIZATION","d"."/SAP/1_SEGMENT","d"."/SAP/1_VALUATIONAREA","d"."/SAP/1_ACCOUNTINGDOCUMENTTYPE","d"."/SAP/1_CUSTOMER","d"."/SAP/1_SERVICEDOCUMENT","d"."/SAP/1_SERVICEDOCUMENTTYPE","d"."/SAP/1_SUPPLIER"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_YY1_FA_JE_ACTUALS_S4_CURR" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'YY1_FA_JE_ACTUALS'

LedgerGLLineItem.@EndUserText.label: General ledger journal entry line item
